idle.says: the whole video, every 3rd picture, played forward only

run.says: one stride cycle, every 2nd picture, played forward only

guard.says: the rise once, the held stretch back and forth, the lowering once

strike.says: the move with its hit, every 3rd picture, 1.5x

strike1x.says: the move with its hit, every 3rd picture, 1x

windup.says: the wind-up, held at its end, every 2nd picture, 1.5x

mudling.name: Mudling
mudling.patternHead:
IMAGE TO VIDEO REQUEST: ONE SHORT ANIMATION CLIP. Return exactly one video, nothing else.

WHAT THIS IS
A short animation of the creature in the attached picture, for a family role-playing game. The attached picture is the first frame. Animate EXACTLY this creature: the same body shape, face, eyes, colors, textures, markings and proportions, and the same hand-painted style. Do not redesign, restyle, simplify or change anything about the creature.

LOOK (must hold in every moment of the clip)
- The exact hand-painted style of the attached picture, with smooth soft shading, in every moment. No heavy dark outlines. Not 3D, not anime, not a flat cartoon, not a photo.
- The creature stays the same size for the whole clip. It keeps the same number of eyes, limbs and other parts as in the picture. Nothing grows, shrinks, splits or morphs into something else.

CAMERA AND BACKGROUND (strict)
- Locked camera. No zoom, no pan, no tilt, no cuts, no shake.
- The creature stays in the same place in the frame. Its base stays pressed on the same line as in the attached picture and never lifts off it, hops or slides. The whole creature stays well inside the frame at all times.
- The creature keeps the same facing and viewing angle as the attached picture for the whole clip (turned to the right).
- The background stays exactly the flat solid pure magenta of the attached picture the whole time, with no change of color, no gradient, no cut and no fade. No magenta glow, halo or tint on the creature. No ground, no cast shadow, no floor shadow, no puddle, no dust, no sparkles, no motion lines, no effects of any kind, no text, no extra creatures or objects.
- Silent. No voice, no music, no sound effects.
mudling.patternTail: Length about 3 seconds. Family friendly for ages 6 and up.

body:mudling:idle.name: Idle (standing and breathing)
body:mudling:idle.prompt:
IMAGE TO VIDEO REQUEST: ONE SHORT ANIMATION CLIP. Return exactly one video, nothing else.

WHAT THIS IS
A short looping animation of the creature in the attached picture, for a family role-playing game. The attached picture is the first frame. Animate EXACTLY this creature: the same body shape, face, eyes, colors, textures, markings and proportions, and the same hand-painted style. Do not redesign, restyle, simplify or change anything about the creature.

LOOK (must hold in every moment of the clip)
- The exact hand-painted style of the attached picture, with smooth soft shading, in every moment. No heavy dark outlines. Not 3D, not anime, not a flat cartoon, not a photo.
- The creature stays the same size for the whole clip. It keeps the same number of eyes, limbs and other parts as in the picture. Nothing grows, shrinks, splits or morphs into something else.

CAMERA AND BACKGROUND (strict)
- Locked camera. No zoom, no pan, no tilt, no cuts, no shake.
- The creature stays in the same place in the frame. Its base stays pressed on the same line as in the attached picture and never lifts off it, hops or slides. The whole creature stays well inside the frame at all times.
- The creature keeps the same facing and viewing angle as the attached picture for the whole clip (turned to the right).
- The background stays exactly the flat solid pure magenta of the attached picture the whole time, with no change of color, no gradient, no cut and no fade. No magenta glow, halo or tint on the creature. No ground, no cast shadow, no floor shadow, no puddle, no dust, no sparkles, no motion lines, no effects of any kind, no text, no extra creatures or objects.
- Silent. No voice, no music, no sound effects.

MOTION: IDLE LOOP
The creature waits in place, alive and curious. Slow breathing: the top of the body swells and settles a little while the base stays put. One slow blink. The eyes glance to one side and back. The leaf sprout on its head sways gently and stays attached. The mud arms stay where they are; drips wobble a little but nothing falls off or lands on the ground. The mouth stays as it is in the attached picture. Keep every motion very small, slow and calm: the creature barely moves.

Length about 3 seconds. Family friendly for ages 6 and up.

brief.does: The idle (standing and breathing) body state.

IMAGE TO VIDEO REQUEST: ONE SHORT ANIMATION CLIP. Return exactly one video, nothing else.

WHAT THIS IS
A short animation of the creature in the attached picture, for a family role-playing game. The attached picture is the first frame. Animate EXACTLY this creature: the same body shape, face, eyes, colors, textures, markings and proportions, and the same hand-painted style. Do not redesign, restyle, simplify or change anything about the creature.

LOOK (must hold in every moment of the clip)
- The exact hand-painted style of the attached picture, with smooth soft shading, in every moment. No heavy dark outlines. Not 3D, not anime, not a flat cartoon, not a photo.
- The creature stays the same size for the whole clip. It keeps the same number of eyes, limbs and other parts as in the picture. Nothing grows, shrinks, splits or morphs into something else.

CAMERA AND BACKGROUND (strict)
- Locked camera. No zoom, no pan, no tilt, no cuts, no shake.
- The creature stays in the same place in the frame. Its base stays pressed on the same line as in the attached picture and never lifts off it, hops or slides. The whole creature stays well inside the frame at all times.
- The creature keeps the same facing and viewing angle as the attached picture for the whole clip (turned to the right).
- The background stays exactly the flat solid pure magenta of the attached picture the whole time, with no change of color, no gradient, no cut and no fade. No magenta glow, halo or tint on the creature. No ground, no cast shadow, no floor shadow, no puddle, no dust, no sparkles, no motion lines, no effects of any kind, no text, no extra creatures or objects.
- Silent. No voice, no music, no sound effects.

MOTION: STATIC DRIFT
The creature flicks one part of itself forward once, as if throwing something small. Without repeating it, it settles back into the pose of the attached picture and stays completely still for the rest of the clip.

Length about 3 seconds. Family friendly for ages 6 and up.
